mapper.select: SELECT origin_kind,actor_ref,responsibility_ref,integration_id,business_scope_id,agent_id,session_id, NULL::text AS root_input_id,NULL::bigint AS deployment_id,NULL::bigint AS deployment_revision, NULL::bigint AS grant_id,NULL::bigint AS grant_revision FROM nw_chat_sessions WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{sessionId}

SELECT origin_kind,actor_ref,responsibility_ref,integration_id,business_scope_id,agent_id,session_id, root_input_id,deployment_id,deployment_revision,grant_id,grant_revision FROM nw_integration_run_sources WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{runId} UNION ALL SELECT 'system' AS origin_kind,'system:'||r.requester_system_principal_id AS actor_ref, 'system-agent:'||r.agent_id AS responsibility_ref,NULL::text AS integration_id,NULL::text AS business_scope_id, r.agent_id::bigint AS agent_id,r.session_id,r.root_input_id, NULL::bigint AS deployment_id,NULL::bigint AS deployment_revision,NULL::bigint AS grant_id,NULL::bigint AS grant_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs r JOIN public.nw_system_agent_runtime_capability_sources s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.session_id=r.session_id AND s.agent_id=r.agent_id AND s.end_user_id=r.end_user_id AND s.input_id=r.input_id JOIN public.nw_runtime_host_owners h ON h.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND h.session_id=s.session_id AND h.agent_id=s.agent_id AND h.end_user_id=s.end_user_id AND h.target_kind=r.target_kind AND h.target_id=r.target_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.run_id=#{runId} AND r.target_kind='AGENT' AND r.target_id=r.agent_id AND r.requester_kind='SYSTEM' AND r.origin_ref=s.source_data ->> 'run_id' AND NULLIF(s.source_data ->> 'prompt_source_ref','') IS NOT NULL

SELECT origin_kind,actor_ref,responsibility_ref,integration_id,NULL::text AS business_scope_id, NULL::bigint AS agent_id,NULL::text AS session_id,NULL::text AS root_input_id, NULL::bigint AS deployment_id,NULL::bigint AS deployment_revision,NULL::bigint AS grant_id,NULL::bigint AS grant_revision FROM nw_control_operations WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND operation_id=#{operationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_integration_run_sources(tenant_id,run_id,parent_run_id,origin_kind,actor_ref,responsibility_ref, integration_id,business_scope_id,agent_id,session_id,root_input_id,deployment_id,deployment_revision,grant_id,grant_revision) VALUES(CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint),#{runId},#{parentRunId},#{source.originKind},#{source.actorRef},#{source.responsibilityRef}, #{source.integrationId},#{source.businessScopeId},#{source.agentId},#{source.sessionId},#{source.rootInputId}, #{source.deploymentId},#{source.deploymentRevision},#{source.grantId},#{source.grantRevision}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO NOTHING
